hypotheses.text: Metformin improves skeletal muscle insulin sensitivity via AMPK activation

claims.text: Metformin inhibits mitochondrial complex I, which activates AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) in skeletal muscle.

references.raw: Zhou G, et al. Role of AMP-activated protein kinase in mechanism of metformin action. J Clin Invest. 2001.
references.title: Role of AMP-activated protein kinase in mechanism of metformin action

claims.text: AMPK activation increases GLUT4 translocation to the cell membrane, improving glucose uptake in skeletal muscle.
Improved skeletal muscle glucose uptake should lower fasting blood glucose in type 2 diabetes.

hypotheses.text: Statins lower cardiovascular risk primarily through HMG-CoA reductase inhibition

claims.text: Statins competitively inhibit HMG-CoA reductase (HMGCR), the rate-limiting enzyme in hepatic cholesterol biosynthesis.

references.raw: Goldstein JL, Brown MS. Regulation of the mevalonate pathway. Nature. 1990.
references.title: Regulation of the mevalonate pathway

claims.text: Reduced hepatic cholesterol synthesis upregulates LDL receptor expression, increasing plasma LDL clearance.
